name: Jeonju Bibimbap Co.
description: The taste of Korea, on and off the track.
story: Jeonju Bibimbap Co. is a South Korean food company dedicated to preserving and promoting the traditional Korean dish, Bibimbap. Recognizing the global reach and excitement of motorsport, they sponsor teams to connect with a wider audience and share their passion for Korean cuisine. They seek a partnership that reflects their values of tradition, quality, and performance.
